race.comment: RIPPER RAE (2) was below best at his last start when 7th at Bendigo following a second place finish (22.51) at this track two back. Has ability and can bounce back. FLEX FACTOR (8) is better than last start when fourth (28.67) from Box 4 at Bendigo over 500m. One of the main contenders. GRAVITY RUSH (4) has been in super consistent form recently with two minors on end before missing the frame latest finishing seventh (26.64) at Warragul. Form here sound including four wins. Must be included in calculations. RED HOT PRETTY (1) can play a role in the finish without surprising.
